This section demonstrates typical OptiWell workflows. 

## Creating a Fluid Model 

To create a fluid model, click the "+" sign to add a new fluid model. In this example, we will select "Black oil" 
as the "Fluid Type" and "Correlations" as the "PVT Method" as shown below. 

The following table presents the PVT data input to create a fluid model. 

**PVT Data**
```{python}
#| echo: false  
 
import pandas as pd  

pvt_props = ["GOR", "Gas gravity", "API", "Salinity", "Watercut", "N2", "CO2", "H2S"]
pvt_vals = [339, 0.727, 24, 1000000, 0.30, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00]

pvt_df = pd.DataFrame({
  "Property": pvt_props, 
  "Value": pvt_vals, 

}) 

pvt_df.style.hide(axis="index")

pvt_df

```

The following is the PVT Modeling Settings options.  

```{python} 
#| echo: false 

 
import pandas as pd


field = ["Bubble Point Correlation", "Solution GOR", "Oil FVF Correlation", "Oil Viscosity Correlation"]  
select_option = ["Standing", "Standing", "Standing", "Beggs-Robinson"]  

model_select_df = pd.DataFrame({
  "Select field": field, 
  "Selected Option": select_option
}) 

model_select_df.style.hide(axis="index")

model_select_df

``` 

Upon making the above inputs and selections, we rename the model and save changes
